headline: Lucid, Nuro and Uber have picked Houston as the next city for their robotaxi service.
score_reason: Expansion of a known plan; the original article could not be read, so the new details are unverified.
importance_line: Houston riders may get a third robotaxi brand after Tesla and Waymo, and Uber deepens its bet on partners' self-driving cars, though the timing and scale of the Houston service are not confirmed.
summary: InsideEVs reports that Houston is the next city where Lucid and Uber will run robotaxis, built on Lucid's Gravity electric SUV with Nuro's self-driving system. Stocktwits, describing the same partnership, places the first commercial service in the San Francisco Bay Area in late 2026 and Houston in mid-2027, with a target of at least 35,000 vehicles over several years.
notes: Original blocked (403); headline plus partnership background from Stocktwits. Score lowered from 6 to 5 as unverified.
